Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Abstract Shapes Wall Art Decor on Canvas - 26 x 48 Inches
Colors: Multicolor
Materials: canvas
Contemporary shapes create this abstract painting on canvas and form the building blocks of modern style. The painting’s striking combination of color and pattern adds instant visual interest for rooms both innovative and elegant. 36"W x 48"H Printed canvas with hand painted details Abstract shapes, angles, and bright color adds interest to your home or office Hanging materials not included
